position.name: Senior Software Engineer - Identity Platform (f/m/d)
position.keywords: Java, Spring Boot, Kotlin, Kafka, PostgreSQL, self-sovereign identity

jobDescription.name: Your Role
jobDescription.value: Verimi is building the identity platform for the future. As a Senior Software Engineer you will design and operate backend services in Java 17 and Spring Boot that power our self-sovereign identity wallet, working alongside a team that also ships Kotlin services.

jobDescription.name: Your Profile
jobDescription.value: 5-7 years of backend engineering experience, deep knowledge of Java/Spring, comfort with distributed systems. We sponsor visas and support relocation to Berlin for the right candidate, including relocation assistance and support with the residence permit process.

jobDescription.name: Your Role
jobDescription.value: As Software Architect you will own the technical direction of our Java/Spring based identity services and mentor senior engineers.

jobDescription.name: Your Profile
jobDescription.value: 7+ years experience, architecture background. Relocation package and work permit support provided.
